scoring_justification: The headline exponents depend on Monte Carlo simulations and histogram reweighting that cannot be recomputed in the lightweight verifier; the paper’s published central values with uncertainties serve as the reference gold, scored with σ‑dependent tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: paper‑reported critical exponents and Binder cumulant crossing value with uncertainties
hidden_assets.generation_method: directly copied from the paper’s final numbers
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: these are the experimental values reported by the paper; they are the target of the reproduction task

required.nu: object with fields value (number) and error (number)

required.Tc: object with fields value (number) and error (number)

outputs.description: The critical exponents (ν, β, γ), critical temperature T_c, and the Binder cumulant crossing value U₄*, together with their uncertainties, obtained from the finite‑size scaling analysis of the simulated data.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares the reported exponents, crossing value, and critical temperature to the paper’s published numbers with a tolerance of a few standard deviations. No other outputs are scored.

steps.description: Check nu, beta, gamma, and U4_crossing values against paper gold with sigma-dependent tolerance.
